problem.passage: Food scientists investigating why certain artisanal cheese varieties develop a distinctive sharp flavor during aging have proposed two competing explanations. One group argues that the flavor intensity depends primarily on the specific strain of bacteria introduced during the initial fermentation stage, with certain strains producing more flavor-compounds over time regardless of storage conditions. Another group contends that the aging environment, particularly humidity and temperature fluctuations in the storage cave, is the dominant factor, and that bacterial strain differences matter little once cheeses are aged under identical conditions. A food scientist named Priya Nandakumar aged batches of cheese made with different bacterial strains under carefully controlled, identical humidity and temperature conditions to compare flavor development.
problem.stimulus: Food scientists investigating why certain artisanal cheese varieties develop a distinctive sharp flavor during aging have proposed two competing explanations. One group argues that the flavor intensity depends primarily on the specific strain of bacteria introduced during the initial fermentation stage, with certain strains producing more flavor-compounds over time regardless of storage conditions. Another group contends that the aging environment, particularly humidity and temperature fluctuations in the storage cave, is the dominant factor, and that bacterial strain differences matter little once cheeses are aged under identical conditions. A food scientist named Priya Nandakumar aged batches of cheese made with different bacterial strains under carefully controlled, identical humidity and temperature conditions to compare flavor development.
problem.question: Which finding from Nandakumar's study, if true, would most directly support the claim that bacterial strain, rather than aging environment, determines flavor intensity?
options: Cheese batches made with a particular bacterial strain developed significantly sharper flavor profiles than other batches even though all batches were aged under identical humidity and temperature conditions.
Cheese batches aged in caves with higher humidity levels developed sharper flavors than batches aged in drier caves, regardless of bacterial strain.
Cheese batches made with different bacterial strains, despite showing different flavor intensities, were all rated equally favorably by taste-testers when aged under identical conditions.

Cheese batches made with a particular bacterial strain developed sharper flavors, but only in batches that were also aged longer than six months, while shorter-aged batches showed no strain-based difference.
problem.explanation: 박테리아 균주 가설은 '저장 조건과 무관하게' 특정 균주가 더 많은 향미 화합물을 생성한다고 주장한다. 습도와 온도가 동일하게 통제된 상태에서도 특정 균주를 사용한 치즈 배치가 더 날카로운 향미를 보였다면, 이는 환경 요인이 아니라 균주 차이가 향미를 결정한다는 것을 직접적으로 뒷받침한다. B는 오히려 숙성 환경 가설을 지지하는 증거다. C는 수분 손실률에 관한 것으로 향미 강도와 직접 관련이 없다. D는 숙성 기간의 효과를 보여줄 뿐 균주와 환경 중 어느 요인이 더 중요한지 구분하지 못한다.
problem.explanationEn: The bacterial-strain hypothesis claims that certain strains produce more flavor compounds 'regardless of storage conditions.' If, even with humidity and temperature held identical across all batches, cheese made with a particular strain still developed a sharper flavor, this directly shows that strain differences, not environmental factors, drive flavor intensity. Option B actually supports the aging-environment hypothesis. Option C concerns moisture loss rates, which are unrelated to flavor intensity directly. Option D shows an aging-duration effect but doesn't distinguish which factor (strain vs. environment) is dominant.
problem.evidenceTarget: Bacterial strain, not aging environment, determines flavor intensity.
problem.evidenceSpan: certain strains producing more flavor-compounds over time regardless of storage conditions
problem.answerRationale: Since humidity and temperature were held constant across all batches, any difference in flavor sharpness must be attributable to the bacterial strain, directly confirming that strain matters even when environmental factors are controlled for.

difficultyReasons: 필요한 추론 단계: 실험 설계(동일 환경 통제)를 이해하고, 그 결과가 어떤 가설을 지지하는지 연결해야 하므로 2단계 추론 필요
핵심 관계의 미묘함: 균주 vs 환경이라는 두 경쟁 가설 중 어느 것이 원인인지 구분해야 함
오답 C는 향미 강도가 아닌 선호도라는 다른 측정치를 다뤄 정답과 표면적으로 유사하지만 질문의 초점(향미 강도)과 어긋남
오답 D는 조건부 효과를 추가하여 단순 인과관계 주장을 약화시키므로 신중히 읽어야 구분 가능

distractors.plausibleBecause: 연구 설계에서 언급된 습도/온도 요인이라는 핵심 변수를 다루고 있어 관련성이 있어 보인다
distractors.matches: 지문의 '아이징 환경(습도, 온도)' 언급과 관련된 표현을 사용함
distractors.whyWrong: 이 결과는 오히려 아이징 환경(습도)이 향미를 결정한다는 반대 주장을 지지하며, 실험 설계상 모든 배치가 동일한 조건에서 숙성되었다는 전제와도 모순된다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 박테리아 균주별 차이와 동일 조건이라는 키워드가 등장해 관련 있어보이지만 결론이 다르다
distractors.matches: 동일한 습도·온도 조건이라는 실험 설정과 균주 간 향미 차이 언급을 포함함
distractors.whyWrong: 향미 강도 차이가 아니라 맛 평가(호감도) 동일성을 다루므로, 균주가 향미 강도를 결정한다는 주장을 직접 뒷받침하지 않음

distractors.plausibleBecause: 균주에 따른 향미 차이라는 핵심 요소를 포함하고 있어 정답과 유사해 보인다
distractors.matches: '특정 균주'로 인한 향미 차이라는 표현이 정답과 동일하게 등장함
distractors.whyWrong: 균주 효과가 숙성 기간이라는 추가 조건에 의존한다는 조건이 붙어 있어, 균주만으로 '항상' 결정된다는 단순한 인과관계를 지지하지 못하고 오히려 시간(조건)이 매개 변수임을 시사함
